body:
The per-Gateway custom-theme work ships an Appearance surface with a new Gateway-themes section, its loading/empty/failure rows and a per-connection selection. Desktop's own picker is rendered from a disposable pinned export (`437116f9497c80d242ce034ff7f5d81dc277a337`) so every row and state can be compared side by side.

This issue tracks the owed rendered report:

- Desktop capture: `apps/desktop/src/app/settings/appearance-settings.tsx` theme grid at the pin, with synthetic themes only, via `.chalk/skills/port-hermes-desktop-surface/scripts/capture-desktop-reference.mjs`.
- Android capture: the same states from `app/src/main/kotlin/com/hermesagent/mobile/ui/appearance/AppearanceScreen.kt`, built into a side-by-side with `build-visual-report.py`.
- States owed: built-ins only (offline), gateway themes present, loading, empty, failed with retry, selected custom theme.
- `docs/parity/appearance-themes.md` names `pending: #<this issue>` until the report lands, then swaps in the report path and the commit it was captured at.

No private endpoint, host, fingerprint or credential may enter a capture.
title: parity: Appearance custom-theme visual report (Desktop vs Android, pinned 437116f9)
